items.docs:
Deprecated in 0.2.0 and removed in 0.3.0. Use Progress (@fibo/progress) instead.
Migrate: pnpm dlx jscodeshift --parser tsx -t https://fibo.toribryan.com/codemods/spinner-to-progress.js src
Docs and live examples: https://fibo.toribryan.com/?path=/docs/base-components-spinner--docs

deprecated.reason: A spinner says nothing about how long a wait will be or what is happening. An indeterminate Progress takes a label, and turns determinate once the total is known.
